Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Brown (C)
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 130 as introduced enumerates the crimes that may result in bail being denied to a defendant. In addition, this bill requires a pretrial detention hearing to be held immediately upon the defendants first appearance before the court.
This bill could increase the obligations of local jails, by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the number of individuals charged with crimes and denied bail by a judge.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 232 as passed the Senate could decrease the potential obligations of county and municipal jails, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of individuals who could have been confined in jail for certain traffic violations and who would now not be confined based on the provisions of this bill.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
